fields.statement: QA at cbdf7a93 with a binary built from the branch (go build ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch repo with a bare origin, RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. Unpushed case: run A (command build workflow) committed on cs/abandon-built, pushed with git push -u origin; run B committed again without pushing; run C failed its check; rhiza run abandon C printed 'remove-worktree done' and 'delete-branch kept: it has commits merged into neither its upstream nor HEAD', and git branch -vv showed cs/abandon-built [origin/cs/abandon-built: ahead 1] with both built commits. Control: same flow without run B (branch fully pushed) printed 'delete-branch done' and the branch was gone. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-abandon-(unpushed|unmerged)$' passed.
